State Elections - Primary - September 01, 2026
Back to List
The State Primary Election was held at Fairbank Community Center, 40 Fairbank Road, which is the location for all 6 precincts.  The polls were open from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM.  There were 3904 votes cast, representing 26.8% of the town's 14,542 registered voters.  The final tabulation was done at the Town Hall.
